scope: Historical source reconciliation of SRI-era Neumann research and the official CTSRD/CHERI inventories. The original broad project import has subsequently been narrowed to direct SRI authorship; see cheri-sri-affiliation-audit-2026-10-09.json for final inclusion decisions.
method: Enumerate the official CTSRD/CHERI inventory, retain its independently numbered reports and dissertations, and deduplicate the thesis/report double listing.
Enumerate Neumann’s DBLP author records; select research papers, books and chapters, then reconcile his selected SRI bibliography, SRI homepage and all 15 entries in the official CSL paper list.
Correct chapter classifications; distinguish conference, journal, report and thesis versions. Use publisher dates where the author bibliography describes a prepublication version.

Preserve source URLs on every record. Missing DOI, pagination or publisher fields are omitted rather than inferred. A source bibliography link is explicitly identified when the original paper is unavailable.
limitations: Neumann’s selected bibliography and CSL list are partial and historical; the CHERI source inventories are maintained independently and may omit newer work. No claim of completeness beyond the enumerated source inventories.

Neumann serial Inside Risks columns, RISKS digests, routine editorials, book reviews, interviews, testimony, event listings and pre-SRI publications are outside this research reconciliation. Selected substantial essays and retrospective articles explicitly listed by the author are retained.
The 2004 Computer Ethics and Professional Responsibility contribution has no chapter title in the selected bibliography; it is not fabricated as a separate record.
The 1975 and 1977 PSOS reports are mentioned in the verified 1980 second-edition record; their precise independent edition metadata has not been established.

The homepage mentions Trustworthy Total-System Integration: Exploration of Hidden Security Problems, and Potential Approaches for Resolving Them without enough independently verified publication metadata for a new entry.

Some legacy SRI links are intermittently unavailable or lead to a bibliography rather than full text. The 1985 IDES, 1986 SIDS and 1988 Secure Distributed Data Views records explicitly point to later source bibliographies.
Committee books use corporate authorship and explicitly credit Neumann’s committee contribution; they are not represented as solely authored books.

The per-source added/existing statuses below describe the original reconciliation. Forty-two project entries were subsequently removed by the SRI authorship audit, including the 2026 linkage-based paper. Draft guide and CTSRD final-report status remain explicitly noted.
